issue.title: Adopt integrated research workflow, source dossier and coherent current roadmap

milestone.title: Native Rust geometric intelligence — conversation, memory, reasoning and coding
milestone.description:
Build useful local geometric intelligence in Rust: preparation, learning, artifacts and inference. Prime/ordered-n-let addresses, fixed zeta phases, R4/S3/H4 state, exact Z[phi]/orientation, typed paired-H4/icosian geometry and UOR identity remain primary. Offline Rust training may use matrix multiplication; serving uses learned bounded geometric routing/state and integer/table operators, with no hidden dense transformer or response provider.

Immediate owner-adopted sequence (2026-09-05): #1137 role-aware shared source selection/commit -> #1138 learned exact relations beyond the raw window -> #1139 selective geometric access at complete cost -> #1140 learned typed operator composition for conversation and Rust reasoning. #973 is the model parent; #820 is the programme tracker. Only the earliest unmet step is immediate work. An accepted behavioral handoff, not mere issue closure, unlocks the next step.

Canonical plan and responsibility consolidation: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md
Actual implementation/artifacts/results: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md

After the four accepted handoffs: broader #954 correctness, #955 reasoning, #962 conversation/service, #1088 coding/workspace, #963 optimization, #964 guarantees/publication and #965 integrated qualification/release. Both alpha capability groups remain unqualified. Historical positive, negative and unavailable results retain their exact scope.

One task/agent; budget-friendly complete cycles and cumulative accounting. Necessary storage increases are preauthorized and recorded; no deletion or paid compute. Protected PR delivery remains required. Planning changes do not establish model capability or geometric advantage.

issue.body:
## Outcome
Adopt the reviewed tooling/knowledge/research/productization plan and make the native roadmap and current documentation coherent with the local CPU-first geometric reasoning/coding target.

## Deliverables
- Land the existing isolated planning worktree: source catalog/reviews, read-only local knowledge MCP/importer, storage inventory, scoped workflow skill, publication readiness audit and initial claim ledger.
- Reconcile current pointers without deleting historical evidence; record the actual #973→#954 artifact/input/state/output handoff.
- Add native ownership/dependency homes for missing integration, language/context, final lowering, coding, publication and capability scorecard work.
- Add a reusable continuation prompt and ingest the accepted map/issue changes into the local knowledge graph.

## Evidence and DoD
The prior tool behavior checks and source audit are retained. Activate only JSON/schema/source-link checks, explicit source/privacy review, current-map consistency, knowledge query/ingest checks and focused package behavior verification needed for this delivery. No model run or broad QA. Independent diff review and the required protected PR transport conclude delivery; acknowledgements are not tests.

## Ownership and next action
Casey-allard is actively executing this adoption. Preserve the original mixed checkout and prior scientific records. The separate #973 construction diagnostic has its own child contract.

The repository now contains the integrated plan, current programme/intake map, reusable continuation prompt, native issue/adoption receipts, deeper pinned NEMESIS/W33 review, source/claim/tooling/publication records, local read-only knowledge MCP plus explicit ingestion tooling, project workflow skill, and read-only storage inventory. Native issues #1082–#1091 and their parent/blocker edges are live; #973–#965 current boundaries were reconciled while preserving historical records. #1082 is the sole active scientific child; other new lanes are planned.

Decision checks: independent source review GO after four findings were resolved; public-source/private-rejection and symlink-escape negative checks passed; selected native graph and document synchronization passed; reimport added zero duplicate items/edges. The accepted 145-record/88-edge update added 130 items and 72 edges. JSON/local-link checks, skill validation and diff hygiene passed. Existing unchanged package/tool evidence was reused. The five GitHub statuses were transport acknowledgements; broad QA, model training/development scoring and publication were NOT_RUN.

The next step has begun separately under #1082's immutable preparation and pre-outcome native freeze. Its outcome does not alter the completed scope here.
